ayahs.text: حمٓ

tr.sahih: Ḥā, Meem.
tr.pickthall: Ha. Mim.

ayahs.text: وَٱلْكِتَـٰبِ ٱلْمُبِينِ

tr.sahih: By the clear Book,
tr.pickthall: By the Scripture that maketh plain

ayahs.text: إِنَّآ أَنزَلْنَـٰهُ فِى لَيْلَةٍ مُّبَـٰرَكَةٍ ۚ إِنَّا كُنَّا مُنذِرِينَ

tr.sahih: Indeed, We sent it down during a blessed night. Indeed, We were to warn [mankind].
tr.pickthall: Lo! We revealed it on a blessed night - Lo! We are ever warning -

ayahs.text: فِيهَا يُفْرَقُ كُلُّ أَمْرٍ حَكِيمٍ

tr.sahih: Therein [i.e., on that night] is made distinct every precise matter -
tr.pickthall: Whereon every wise command is made clear

ayahs.text: أَمْرًا مِّنْ عِندِنَآ ۚ إِنَّا كُنَّا مُرْسِلِينَ

tr.sahih: [Every] matter [proceeding] from Us. Indeed, We were to send [a messenger]
tr.pickthall: As a command from Our presence - Lo! We are ever sending -

ayahs.text: رَحْمَةً مِّن رَّبِّكَ ۚ إِنَّهُۥ هُوَ ٱلسَّمِيعُ ٱلْعَلِيمُ

tr.sahih: As mercy from your Lord. Indeed, He is the Hearing, the Knowing,
tr.pickthall: A mercy from thy Lord. Lo! He, even He is the Hearer, the Knower,

ayahs.text: رَبِّ ٱلسَّمَـٰوَٰتِ وَٱلْأَرْضِ وَمَا بَيْنَهُمَآ ۖ إِن كُنتُم مُّوقِنِينَ

tr.sahih: Lord of the heavens and the earth and that between them, if you would be certain.
tr.pickthall: Lord of the heavens and the earth and all that is between them, if ye would be sure.

ayahs.text: لَآ إِلَـٰهَ إِلَّا هُوَ يُحْىِۦ وَيُمِيتُ ۖ رَبُّكُمْ وَرَبُّ ءَابَآئِكُمُ ٱلْأَوَّلِينَ

tr.sahih: There is no deity except Him; He gives life and causes death. [He is] your Lord and the Lord of your first forefathers.
tr.pickthall: There is no Allah save Him. He quickeneth and giveth death; your Lord and Lord of your forefathers.

ayahs.text: بَلْ هُمْ فِى شَكٍّ يَلْعَبُونَ

tr.sahih: But they are in doubt, amusing themselves.
tr.pickthall: Nay, but they play in doubt.

ayahs.text: فَٱرْتَقِبْ يَوْمَ تَأْتِى ٱلسَّمَآءُ بِدُخَانٍ مُّبِينٍ

tr.sahih: Then watch for the Day when the sky will bring a visible smoke
tr.pickthall: But watch thou (O Muhammad) for the day when the sky will produce visible smoke

ayahs.text: يَغْشَى ٱلنَّاسَ ۖ هَـٰذَا عَذَابٌ أَلِيمٌ

tr.sahih: Covering the people; this is a painful torment.
tr.pickthall: That will envelop the people. This will be a painful torment.

ayahs.text: رَّبَّنَا ٱكْشِفْ عَنَّا ٱلْعَذَابَ إِنَّا مُؤْمِنُونَ

tr.sahih: [They will say], "Our Lord, remove from us the torment; indeed, we are believers."
tr.pickthall: (Then they will say): Our Lord relieve us of the torment. Lo! we are believers.

ayahs.text: أَنَّىٰ لَهُمُ ٱلذِّكْرَىٰ وَقَدْ جَآءَهُمْ رَسُولٌ مُّبِينٌ

tr.sahih: How will there be for them a reminder [at that time]? And there had come to them a clear Messenger.
tr.pickthall: How can there be remembrance for them, when a messenger making plain (the Truth) had already come unto them,

ayahs.text: ثُمَّ تَوَلَّوْا۟ عَنْهُ وَقَالُوا۟ مُعَلَّمٌ مَّجْنُونٌ

tr.sahih: Then they turned away from him and said, "[He was] taught [and is] a madman."
tr.pickthall: And they had turned away from him and said: One taught (by others), a madman?

ayahs.text: إِنَّا كَاشِفُوا۟ ٱلْعَذَابِ قَلِيلًا ۚ إِنَّكُمْ عَآئِدُونَ

tr.sahih: Indeed, We will remove the torment for a little. Indeed, you [disbelievers] will return [to disbelief].
tr.pickthall: Lo! We withdraw the torment a little. Lo! ye return (to disbelief).

ayahs.text: يَوْمَ نَبْطِشُ ٱلْبَطْشَةَ ٱلْكُبْرَىٰٓ إِنَّا مُنتَقِمُونَ

tr.sahih: The Day We will strike with the greatest assault, indeed, We will take retribution.
tr.pickthall: On the day when We shall seize them with the greater seizure, (then) in truth We shall punish.

ayahs.text: ۞ وَلَقَدْ فَتَنَّا قَبْلَهُمْ قَوْمَ فِرْعَوْنَ وَجَآءَهُمْ رَسُولٌ كَرِيمٌ

tr.sahih: And We had already tried before them the people of Pharaoh, and there came to them a noble messenger [i.e., Moses],
tr.pickthall: And verily We tried before them Pharaoh's folk, when there came unto them a noble messenger,

ayahs.text: أَنْ أَدُّوٓا۟ إِلَىَّ عِبَادَ ٱللَّهِ ۖ إِنِّى لَكُمْ رَسُولٌ أَمِينٌ

tr.sahih: [Saying], "Render to me the servants of Allāh. Indeed, I am to you a trustworthy messenger,"
tr.pickthall: Saying: Give up to me the slaves of Allah. Lo! I am a faithful messenger unto you.

ayahs.text: وَأَن لَّا تَعْلُوا۟ عَلَى ٱللَّهِ ۖ إِنِّىٓ ءَاتِيكُم بِسُلْطَـٰنٍ مُّبِينٍ

tr.sahih: And [saying], "Be not haughty with Allāh. Indeed, I have come to you with clear evidence.
tr.pickthall: And saying: Be not proud against Allah. Lo! I bring you a clear warrant.

ayahs.text: وَإِنِّى عُذْتُ بِرَبِّى وَرَبِّكُمْ أَن تَرْجُمُونِ

tr.sahih: And indeed, I have sought refuge in my Lord and your Lord, lest you stone me.
tr.pickthall: And lo! I have sought refuge in my Lord and your Lord lest ye stone me to death.

ayahs.text: وَإِن لَّمْ تُؤْمِنُوا۟ لِى فَٱعْتَزِلُونِ

tr.sahih: But if you do not believe me, then leave me alone."
tr.pickthall: And if ye put no faith in me, then let me go.

ayahs.text: فَدَعَا رَبَّهُۥٓ أَنَّ هَـٰٓؤُلَآءِ قَوْمٌ مُّجْرِمُونَ

tr.sahih: And [finally] he called to his Lord that these were a criminal people.
tr.pickthall: And he cried unto his Lord, (saying): These are guilty folk.

ayahs.text: فَأَسْرِ بِعِبَادِى لَيْلًا إِنَّكُم مُّتَّبَعُونَ

tr.sahih: [Allāh said], "Then set out with My servants by night. Indeed, you are to be pursued.
tr.pickthall: Then (his Lord commanded): Take away My slaves by night. Lo! ye will be followed,

ayahs.text: وَٱتْرُكِ ٱلْبَحْرَ رَهْوًا ۖ إِنَّهُمْ جُندٌ مُّغْرَقُونَ

tr.sahih: And leave the sea in stillness. Indeed, they are an army to be drowned."
tr.pickthall: And leave the sea behind at rest, for lo! they are a drowned host.

ayahs.text: كَمْ تَرَكُوا۟ مِن جَنَّـٰتٍ وَعُيُونٍ

tr.sahih: How much they left behind of gardens and springs
tr.pickthall: How many were the gardens and the watersprings that they left behind,

ayahs.text: وَزُرُوعٍ وَمَقَامٍ كَرِيمٍ

tr.sahih: And crops and noble sites
tr.pickthall: And the cornlands and the goodly sites

ayahs.text: وَنَعْمَةٍ كَانُوا۟ فِيهَا فَـٰكِهِينَ

tr.sahih: And comfort wherein they were amused.
tr.pickthall: And pleasant things wherein they took delight!

ayahs.text: كَذَٰلِكَ ۖ وَأَوْرَثْنَـٰهَا قَوْمًا ءَاخَرِينَ

tr.sahih: Thus. And We caused to inherit it another people.
tr.pickthall: Even so (it was), and We made it an inheritance for other folk;

ayahs.text: فَمَا بَكَتْ عَلَيْهِمُ ٱلسَّمَآءُ وَٱلْأَرْضُ وَمَا كَانُوا۟ مُنظَرِينَ

tr.sahih: And the heaven and earth wept not for them, nor were they reprieved.
tr.pickthall: And the heaven and the earth wept not for them, nor were they reprieved.

ayahs.text: وَلَقَدْ نَجَّيْنَا بَنِىٓ إِسْرَٰٓءِيلَ مِنَ ٱلْعَذَابِ ٱلْمُهِينِ

tr.sahih: And We certainly saved the Children of Israel from the humiliating torment -
tr.pickthall: And We delivered the Children of Israel from the shameful doom;

ayahs.text: مِن فِرْعَوْنَ ۚ إِنَّهُۥ كَانَ عَالِيًا مِّنَ ٱلْمُسْرِفِينَ

tr.sahih: From Pharaoh. Indeed, he was a haughty one among the transgressors.
tr.pickthall: (We delivered them) from Pharaoh. Lo! he was a tyrant of the wanton ones.

ayahs.text: وَلَقَدِ ٱخْتَرْنَـٰهُمْ عَلَىٰ عِلْمٍ عَلَى ٱلْعَـٰلَمِينَ

tr.sahih: And We certainly chose them by knowledge over [all] the worlds.
tr.pickthall: And We chose them, purposely, above (all) creatures.

ayahs.text: وَءَاتَيْنَـٰهُم مِّنَ ٱلْـَٔايَـٰتِ مَا فِيهِ بَلَـٰٓؤٌا۟ مُّبِينٌ

tr.sahih: And We gave them of signs that in which there was a clear trial.
tr.pickthall: And We gave them portents wherein was a clear trial.

ayahs.text: إِنَّ هَـٰٓؤُلَآءِ لَيَقُولُونَ

tr.sahih: Indeed, these [disbelievers] are saying,
tr.pickthall: Lo! these, forsooth, are saying:

ayahs.text: إِنْ هِىَ إِلَّا مَوْتَتُنَا ٱلْأُولَىٰ وَمَا نَحْنُ بِمُنشَرِينَ

tr.sahih: "There is not but our first death, and we will not be resurrected.
tr.pickthall: There is naught but our first death, and we shall not be raised again.

ayahs.text: فَأْتُوا۟ بِـَٔابَآئِنَآ إِن كُنتُمْ صَـٰدِقِينَ

tr.sahih: Then bring [back] our forefathers, if you should be truthful."
tr.pickthall: Bring back our fathers, if ye speak the truth!

ayahs.text: أَهُمْ خَيْرٌ أَمْ قَوْمُ تُبَّعٍ وَٱلَّذِينَ مِن قَبْلِهِمْ ۚ أَهْلَكْنَـٰهُمْ ۖ إِنَّهُمْ كَانُوا۟ مُجْرِمِينَ

tr.sahih: Are they better or the people of Tubbaʿ and those before them? We destroyed them, [for] indeed, they were criminals.
tr.pickthall: Are they better, or the folk of Tubb'a and those before them? We destroyed them, for surely they were guilty.

ayahs.text: وَمَا خَلَقْنَا ٱلسَّمَـٰوَٰتِ وَٱلْأَرْضَ وَمَا بَيْنَهُمَا لَـٰعِبِينَ

tr.sahih: And We did not create the heavens and earth and that between them in play.
tr.pickthall: And We created not the heavens and the earth, and all that is between them, in play.

ayahs.text: مَا خَلَقْنَـٰهُمَآ إِلَّا بِٱلْحَقِّ وَلَـٰكِنَّ أَكْثَرَهُمْ لَا يَعْلَمُونَ

tr.sahih: We did not create them except in truth, but most of them do not know.
tr.pickthall: We created them not save with truth; but most of them know not.

ayahs.text: إِنَّ يَوْمَ ٱلْفَصْلِ مِيقَـٰتُهُمْ أَجْمَعِينَ

tr.sahih: Indeed, the Day of Judgement is the appointed time for them all -
tr.pickthall: Assuredly the Day of Decision is the term for all of them,

ayahs.text: يَوْمَ لَا يُغْنِى مَوْلًى عَن مَّوْلًى شَيْـًٔا وَلَا هُمْ يُنصَرُونَ

tr.sahih: The Day when no relation will avail a relation at all, nor will they be helped -
tr.pickthall: A day when friend can in naught avail friend, nor can they be helped,

ayahs.text: إِلَّا مَن رَّحِمَ ٱللَّهُ ۚ إِنَّهُۥ هُوَ ٱلْعَزِيزُ ٱلرَّحِيمُ

tr.sahih: Except those [believers] on whom Allāh has mercy. Indeed, He is the Exalted in Might, the Merciful.
tr.pickthall: Save him on whom Allah hath mercy. Lo! He is the Mighty, the Merciful.

ayahs.text: إِنَّ شَجَرَتَ ٱلزَّقُّومِ

tr.sahih: Indeed, the tree of zaqqūm
tr.pickthall: Lo! the tree of Zaqqum,

ayahs.text: طَعَامُ ٱلْأَثِيمِ

tr.sahih: Is food for the sinful.
tr.pickthall: The food of the sinner!

ayahs.text: كَٱلْمُهْلِ يَغْلِى فِى ٱلْبُطُونِ

tr.sahih: Like murky oil, it boils within bellies
tr.pickthall: Like molten brass, it seetheth in their bellies

ayahs.text: كَغَلْىِ ٱلْحَمِيمِ

tr.sahih: Like the boiling of scalding water.
tr.pickthall: As the seething of boiling water.

ayahs.text: خُذُوهُ فَٱعْتِلُوهُ إِلَىٰ سَوَآءِ ٱلْجَحِيمِ

tr.sahih: [It will be commanded], "Seize him and drag him into the midst of the Hellfire,
tr.pickthall: (And it will be said): Take him and drag him to the midst of hell,

ayahs.text: ثُمَّ صُبُّوا۟ فَوْقَ رَأْسِهِۦ مِنْ عَذَابِ ٱلْحَمِيمِ

tr.sahih: Then pour over his head from the torment of scalding water."
tr.pickthall: Then pour upon his head the torment of boiling water.

ayahs.text: ذُقْ إِنَّكَ أَنتَ ٱلْعَزِيزُ ٱلْكَرِيمُ

tr.sahih: [It will be said], "Taste! Indeed, you are the honored, the noble!
tr.pickthall: (Saying): Taste! Lo! thou wast forsooth the mighty, the noble!

ayahs.text: إِنَّ هَـٰذَا مَا كُنتُم بِهِۦ تَمْتَرُونَ

tr.sahih: Indeed, this is what you used to dispute."
tr.pickthall: Lo! this is that whereof ye used to doubt.

ayahs.text: إِنَّ ٱلْمُتَّقِينَ فِى مَقَامٍ أَمِينٍ

tr.sahih: Indeed, the righteous will be in a secure place:
tr.pickthall: Lo! those who kept their duty will be in a place secured.

ayahs.text: فِى جَنَّـٰتٍ وَعُيُونٍ

tr.sahih: Within gardens and springs,
tr.pickthall: Amid gardens and watersprings,

ayahs.text: يَلْبَسُونَ مِن سُندُسٍ وَإِسْتَبْرَقٍ مُّتَقَـٰبِلِينَ

tr.sahih: Wearing [garments of] fine silk and brocade, facing each other.
tr.pickthall: Attired in silk and silk embroidery, facing one another.

ayahs.text: كَذَٰلِكَ وَزَوَّجْنَـٰهُم بِحُورٍ عِينٍ

tr.sahih: Thus. And We will marry them to fair women with large, [beautiful] eyes.
tr.pickthall: Even so (it will be). And We shall wed them unto fair ones with wide, lovely eyes.

ayahs.text: يَدْعُونَ فِيهَا بِكُلِّ فَـٰكِهَةٍ ءَامِنِينَ

tr.sahih: They will call therein for every [kind of] fruit - safe and secure.
tr.pickthall: They call therein for every fruit in safety.

ayahs.text: لَا يَذُوقُونَ فِيهَا ٱلْمَوْتَ إِلَّا ٱلْمَوْتَةَ ٱلْأُولَىٰ ۖ وَوَقَىٰهُمْ عَذَابَ ٱلْجَحِيمِ

tr.sahih: They will not taste death therein except the first death, and He will have protected them from the punishment of Hellfire
tr.pickthall: They taste not death therein, save the first death. And He hath saved them from the doom of hell,

ayahs.text: فَضْلًا مِّن رَّبِّكَ ۚ ذَٰلِكَ هُوَ ٱلْفَوْزُ ٱلْعَظِيمُ

tr.sahih: As bounty from your Lord. That is what is the great attainment.
tr.pickthall: A bounty from thy Lord. That is the supreme triumph.

ayahs.text: فَإِنَّمَا يَسَّرْنَـٰهُ بِلِسَانِكَ لَعَلَّهُمْ يَتَذَكَّرُونَ

tr.sahih: And indeed, We have eased it [i.e., the Qur’ān] in your tongue that they might be reminded.
tr.pickthall: And We have made (this Scripture) easy in thy language only that they may heed.

ayahs.text: فَٱرْتَقِبْ إِنَّهُم مُّرْتَقِبُونَ

tr.sahih: So watch, [O Muḥammad]; indeed, they are watching [for your end].
tr.pickthall: Wait then (O Muhammad). Lo! they (too) are waiting.
